title: Cylindrical object
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. On the first face, draw two circles in the first loop and the second loop. The first circle has a center at coordinates (0.014, 0.014) with a radius of 0.014, while the second circle shares the same center but has a smaller radius of 0.0038. Scale the entire sketch by a factor of 0.028. Rotate the scaled sketch using the same Euler angles and translate it using the same translation vector. Extrude the sketch along the normal direction by 0.75 units and opposite the normal by 0.0 units to create a new solid body. The final dimensions of the cylindrical object will be a length of 0.02805 meters, a width of 0.02805 meters, and a height of 0.75 meters.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the center and radius of the circles
center = (0.014, 0.014)
radius_outer = 0.014
radius_inner = 0.0038

# Create the outer circle
r = r.center(center[0], center[1]).circle(radius_outer)

# Create the inner circle (for the hole)
r = r.circle(radius_inner)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
r = r.extrude(0.75)

# The final model is represented as 'r'

lanes.label: Cadabra 4B (ours) · 1 sample
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.014, 0.014)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.014)         # Draw the outer circle
    .circle(0.0058)        # Draw the inner circle
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder

import cadquery as cq

# Create a hollow cylindrical tube
# Outer diameter: 0.028, Length: 0.75
# The top and isometric views show a through hole along the axis

outer_radius = 0.028 / 2.0
wall_thickness = 0.005
inner_radius = outer_radius - wall_thickness
length = 0.75

r = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .circle(outer_radius)
    .circle(inner_radius)
    .extrude(length)
)
